Name: KB
Query:
WITH knowledge_base_event_rows AS (
			SELECT
				conversation_event_d.conversation_id AS conversation_id,
				conversation_event_d.agent_user_id AS agent_user_id,
				conversation_start_time, event_id, event_type
			FROM
				conversation_event_d
			WHERE
				agent_user_id <> ''
				AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
			)
		SELECT agent_user_id,
			COUNT(DISTINCT IF(event_type = 13, event_id, NULL)) AS total_kb_search_count,
			COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
			COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
		FROM knowledge_base_event_rows
		GROUP BY agent_user_id

					JSONExtractString(
						JSONExtractString(

						'sessionId') AS session_metadata_id
				FROM
					conversation_event_d
				WHERE
					agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters

Name: GenAI
Query:
WITH messages AS (
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
				FROM
					(SELECT message_d.conversation_id AS conversation_id,
    message_d.conversation_start_time AS conversation_start_time,
    message_d.agent_user_id AS agent_user_id,
    message_d.message_id AS message_id FROM message_d
   WHERE conversation_source IN (0, 8)
    AND is_dev_user = 0
    AND agent_user_id <> ''
    
    AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
) AS message_d
				GROUP BY agent_user_id
			),
			action_annotations AS (
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN action_type = 22 THEN action_annotation_id END) AS question_extraction_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN action_type = 24 THEN knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id END) AS retrieval_article_count
				FROM
					(SELECT action_annotation_d.conversation_id AS conversation_id,
    action_annotation_d.conversation_start_time AS conversation_start_time,
    action_annotation_d.agent_user_id AS agent_user_id,
    action_annotation_d.action_annotation_id AS action_annotation_id,
    action_annotation_d.action_type AS action_type,
    action_annotation_d.knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id AS knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id FROM action_annotation_d
   WHERE conversation_source IN (0, 8)
    AND is_dev_user = 0
    AND agent_user_id <> ''
    AND knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id <> ''
     AND action_type in (22, 24)  -- (RETRIEVAL_QUESTION, RETRIEVAL_ARTICLE)

    AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
) AS action_annotation_d
				GROUP BY agent_user_id
			),
			moment_annotations AS (
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id) AS answer_used_count
				FROM
					(SELECT moment_annotation_d.conversation_id AS conversation_id,
    moment_annotation_d.conversation_start_time AS conversation_start_time,
    moment_annotation_d.agent_user_id AS agent_user_id,
    moment_annotation_d.moment_annotation_id AS moment_annotation_id,
    moment_annotation_d.moment_type AS moment_type,
    moment_annotation_d.knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id AS knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id FROM moment_annotation_d
   WHERE conversation_source IN (0, 8)
    AND is_dev_user = 0
    AND agent_user_id <> ''
    AND knowledge_payload_knowledge_session_id <> ''
     AND moment_type = 38  -- KA_GEN_AI_REPLY_USED

    AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
) AS moment_annotation_d
				GROUP BY agent_user_id
			)
			SELECT
				messages.agent_user_id,
				action_annotations.retrieval_article_count AS gen_ai_answer_viewed_count,
				moment_annotations.answer_used_count AS gen_ai_answer_used_count,
				action_annotations.question_extraction_count AS knowledge_moments_detected_count,
				messages.user_count
			FROM
				messages
				LEFT JOIN action_annotations ON messages.agent_user_id = action_annotations.agent_user_id
				LEFT JOIN moment_annotations ON messages.agent_user_id = moment_annotations.agent_user_id

Name: Summary
Query:
WITH
			conversation_stats AS (
				SELECT agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
				FROM 
					conversation_d
				WHERE
					agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
				-- GROUP BY is optional.
				GROUP BY agent_user_id
			),
						convo_with_valid_summarization AS (
				SELECT DISTINCT
					conversation_id, conversation_start_time, agent_user_id
				FROM
					action_annotation_d
				WHERE
					agent_user_id <> ''
					AND summarization_payload_is_valid_summary = 1
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
			),
			convo_with_used_summarization AS (
				SELECT DISTINCT
					conversation_id, conversation_start_time, agent_user_id
				FROM
					conversation_event_d
				WHERE
					agent_user_id <> ''
					AND event_type = 16 -- 16: USED_SUMMARIZATION
					AND summarization_payload_data_type IN (1, 2)  -- 1: CopyAllNotes, 2: CopySummarizationNote
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
			),

			summarization_stats AS (
				SELECT agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT convo_with_valid_summarization.conversation_id) AS generated_summarization_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN convo_with_used_summarization.conversation_id <> '' THEN convo_with_used_summarization.conversation_id END) AS used_summarization_count
				FROM
					convo_with_valid_summarization
 LEFT JOIN convo_with_used_summarization USING (conversation_id, conversation_start_time, agent_user_id)
				-- GROUP BY is optional.
				GROUP BY agent_user_id
			)
			SELECT 
				agent_user_id,
				SUM(generated_summarization_count) AS generated_summarization_count, 
				SUM(used_summarization_count) AS used_summarization_count,
				MAX(convo_count) AS convo_count, 
				MAX(user_count) AS user_count
			FROM 
				conversation_stats LEFT JOIN summarization_stats USING (agent_user_id)
			-- GROUP BY is optional.
			GROUP BY agent_user_id

				AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters

		agent_hourly_conversation AS (
			SELECT DISTINCT
				agent_user_id,
				DATE_TRUNC('hour', conversation_start_time) AS event_time
			FROM
				conversation_d
			WHERE
				agent_user_id <> ''
				AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
		), 
		agent_hourly_smart_compose_stats AS (
			SELECT
				agent_user_id,
				DATE_TRUNC('hour', event_time) AS event_time,
				COUNT(DISTINCT
					DATE_TRUNC('hour', event_time),
					JSONExtractString(JSONExtractString(toJSONString(event_payload), 'smartComposeInserted'), 'smartComposeText')
				) AS smart_compose_used_count
			FROM 
				analytics_event_d
			WHERE TRUE
				AND event_name = 'ChatAgentAssist.SmartCompose.Insert.SmartComposeText'
				AND agent_user_id <> ''
				AND ((event_time >= ?) AND (event_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
			GROUP BY agent_user_id, event_time

			SELECT
				agent_user_id,

					JOIN agent_hourly_conversation USING (agent_user_id, event_time)
			-- GROUP BY is optional.
			GROUP BY agent_user_id
		)
		SELECT 
			agent_user_id,
			SUM(total_smart_compose_used_count),
			MAX(convo_count), MAX(user_count)
		FROM
			conversation_stats LEFT JOIN smart_compose_stats USING (agent_user_id)
		-- GROUP BY is optional.
		GROUP BY agent_user_id
